lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: I'm taking my pet rock for a walk.
lines.script: [earnest, proud] I'm taking my pet rock for a walk.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: He's shy. Please don't make eye contact.
lines.script: [whispering, protective] He's shy. Please don't make eye contact.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Excellent. He's already learned 'stay'.
lines.script: [delighted] Excellent. [deadpan, proud] He's already learned 'stay'.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: My rock says happy birthday. He's on the counter. Please don't frost him.
lines.script: [warm, sincere] My rock says happy birthday. [gently] He's on the counter. Please don't frost him.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Can my rock come? He's never been to a party.
lines.script: [hopeful] Can my rock come? [quietly] He's never been to a party.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: He gets nervous around cake. He'll be fine. He's a rock.
lines.script: [confiding] He gets nervous around cake. [deadpan] He'll be fine. He's a rock.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Then we'll be there. Both of us. He'll bring a gift. It's a smaller rock.
lines.script: [happy, earnest] Then we'll be there. Both of us. [deadpan, proud] He'll bring a gift. It's a smaller rock.

lines.speaker: Moss
lines.text: I asked a tree for directions.
lines.script: [dreamy, slow] I asked a tree for directions.

lines.speaker: Moss
lines.text: It said nothing. Very mysterious.
lines.script: [slow, thoughtful] It said nothing. [dreamy] Very mysterious.

lines.speaker: Moss
lines.text: I think I'm barking up the wrong tree.
lines.script: [dreamy, slow, quietly pleased with himself] I think I'm barking up the wrong tree.

lines.speaker: Moss
lines.text: I brought a tree. A small one. It said it wanted to come.
lines.script: [sleepy, matter-of-fact] I brought a tree. A small one. [dreamy] It said it wanted to come.

lines.speaker: Moss
lines.text: I asked the tree if I should go.
lines.script: [dreamy] I asked the tree if I should go.

lines.speaker: Moss
lines.text: It said nothing. That means yes. Trees are very supportive.
lines.script: [slow, serene] It said nothing. That means yes. [pleased] Trees are very supportive.

lines.speaker: Moss
lines.text: Also, the tree says a freezer went north this morning. Humming. It wasn't happy.
lines.script: [dreamy, concerned] Also, the tree says a freezer went north this morning. Humming. [quiet, sad] It wasn't happy.

lines.speaker: Moss
lines.text: I already did. It said nothing. Very gracious.
lines.script: [sleepy, content] I already did. It said nothing. [pleased] Very gracious.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: Twelve people, one duck, one cow. I counted twice. The freezer counts as a person.
lines.script: [crisp, businesslike] Twelve people, one duck, one cow. I counted twice. [deadpan] The freezer counts as a person.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: Nine candles, one breath. I counted. Perfect score.
lines.script: [proud, crisp] Nine candles, one breath. I counted. [satisfied] Perfect score.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: Nine years. Nine scoops. Nine candles. That's twenty-seven nines. I'll be there.
lines.script: [brisk, pleased] Nine years. Nine scoops. Nine candles. That's twenty-seven nines. [crisp] I'll be there.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: I'll count the guests. Somebody has to.
lines.script: [crisp, matter-of-fact] I'll count the guests. Somebody has to.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: One duck. Counted.
lines.script: [crisp, satisfied] One duck. Counted.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: Ten doors and THREE gaps in the trees now. Somebody opened one by the school.
lines.script: [alarmed, crisp] Ten doors and THREE gaps in the trees now. [indignant] Somebody opened one by the school.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: I had to start all over. I'm at four hundred and six.
lines.script: [flat, deflated] I had to start all over. I'm at four hundred and six.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: You got the tin back? Ten doors, two gaps, one pie tin. All accounted for.
lines.script: [crisp, relieved] You got the tin back? [satisfied] Ten doors, two gaps, one pie tin. All accounted for.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: A mud blob ran through the Square with a pie tin. One blob. One tin. I counted.
lines.script: [precise, amazed] A mud blob ran through the Square with a pie tin. [crisp] One blob. One tin. I counted.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: It went north. Into the gap in the trees. Gap number one.
lines.script: [precise, pointing] It went north. Into the gap in the trees. Gap number one.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: This town has ten doors and two gaps in the trees.
lines.script: [crisp, proud] This town has ten doors and two gaps in the trees.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: I've counted them seventeen times.
lines.script: [proud, crisp] I've counted them seventeen times.

lines.speaker: Dot
lines.text: Tomorrow I'm moving on to windows.
lines.script: [brisk, excited] Tomorrow I'm moving on to windows.

lines.speaker: Bean
lines.text: A mud blob just ran past me carrying a pie.
lines.script: [cheerful, amazed] A mud blob just ran past me carrying a pie.

lines.speaker: Bean
lines.text: I didn't stop it. I collect wrong turns, not pies.
lines.script: [breezy, unbothered] I didn't stop it. I collect wrong turns, not pies.

lines.speaker: Bean
lines.text: Boppy went by with a fishing rod and a jar of peppers.
lines.script: [chatty] Boppy went by with a fishing rod and a jar of peppers.

lines.speaker: Bean
lines.text: He was walking slower than me. Nobody walks slower than me. I collect slow walks too, now.
lines.script: [chatty, wondering] He was walking slower than me. [amazed] Nobody walks slower than me. [cheerful] I collect slow walks too, now.

lines.speaker: Bean
lines.text: I'm not lost. I'm collecting wrong turns.
lines.script: [cheerful, unbothered] I'm not lost. I'm collecting wrong turns.

lines.speaker: Bean
lines.text: That pond up north owes me an apology.
lines.script: [huffy, cheerful] That pond up north owes me an apology.

lines.speaker: Bean
lines.text: Long story. Short socks.
lines.script: [wry] Long story. [deadpan] Short socks.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: Oh! Tom. Girls. Welcome to the Hush Library. Everything is fine.
lines.script: [whispering, bright, too casual] Oh! Tom. Girls. Welcome to the Hush Library. [whispering, brittle] Everything is fine.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: ...It's not fine. It started a week ago. It comes up from the Stacks, downstairs. The old part.
lines.script: [whispering, trailing off] ...It's not fine. It started a week ago. [hushed, uneasy] It comes up from the Stacks, downstairs. The old part.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: Every book down there's whispering. Everything they ever heard. Seventy years of people reading quietly and thinking nobody was listening.
lines.script: [hushed, awed] Every book down there's whispering. Everything they ever heard. [dry] Seventy years of people reading quietly and thinking nobody was listening.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: Books overhear EVERYTHING. That's why we whisper in here. It was never for the people. It's for the books.
lines.script: [whispering, emphatic] Books overhear EVERYTHING. [dry] That's why we whisper in here. [softly, tender] It was never for the people. It's for the books.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: There are three sections. Fiction, Nonfiction and Picture Books. And the Reading Room, at the very back.
lines.script: [whispering, precise] There are three sections. Fiction, Nonfiction and Picture Books. [dry] And the Reading Room, at the very back.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: The Reading Room doors use the old card catalog lock. I lost the password in 1998.
lines.script: [whispering, dry] The Reading Room doors use the old card catalog lock. [deadpan] I lost the password in 1998.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: Then you're in charge of the signs. Here. The staff door is open.
lines.script: [whispering, brisk, relieved] Then you're in charge of the signs. Here. The staff door is open.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: Please be careful. And please, don't answer the books. It only encourages them.
lines.script: [whispering, anxious] Please be careful. [dry, sincere] And please, don't answer the books. It only encourages them.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: Listen. It's quiet. Properly quiet. The good kind. The dictionaries are snoring.
lines.script: [whispering, soft, relieved] Listen. It's quiet. Properly quiet. The good kind. [dry, fond] The dictionaries are snoring.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: Then we'll read it. Story time, Saturdays, out loud. And I think I know who should do the voices.
lines.script: [whispering, warm] Then we'll read it. Story time, Saturdays, out loud. [fond] And I think I know who should do the voices.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: Grace. This is for you. A Gold Library Card. No limit. No late fees. Ever.
lines.script: [whispering, warm, ceremonial] Grace. This is for you. A Gold Library Card. [dry] No limit. No late fees. Ever.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: And sweaters. I knit one every winter. I have run out of people. Please take some.
lines.script: [whispering, shy] And sweaters. I knit one every winter. [deadpan] I have run out of people. [hopeful] Please take some.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: It's quiet. Properly quiet. The good kind. Thank you, Tom.
lines.script: [whispering, soft, grateful] It's quiet. Properly quiet. The good kind. Thank you, Tom.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: Story time is Saturdays now. The Unread asked for Grace. By name.
lines.script: [whispering, warm] Story time is Saturdays now. [dry, amused] The Unread asked for Grace. By name.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: The Stacks are through the staff door. Please be careful. And please don't answer the books.
lines.script: [whispering, brisk] The Stacks are through the staff door. [anxious] Please be careful. [dry] And please don't answer the books.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: I'm fine. Everything is fine. The dictionaries haven't slept in a week.
lines.script: [whispering, brittle, tired] I'm fine. Everything is fine. [dry] The dictionaries haven't slept in a week.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: It's fine. Everything is fine. Please whisper.
lines.script: [whispering, brittle] It's fine. Everything is fine. [firm, gentle] Please whisper.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: ...Did you hear that? That wasn't me. I'd know my own shush.
lines.script: [whispering, trailing off] ...Did you hear that? [hushed, offended] That wasn't me. I'd know my own shush.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: Please whisper. The dictionaries are sleeping.
lines.script: [whispering, precise] Please whisper. The dictionaries are sleeping.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: Someone shelved a sandwich under 'S'.
lines.script: [whispering, scandalized] Someone shelved a sandwich under 'S'.

lines.speaker: Page
lines.text: Technically correct. Deeply concerning.
lines.script: [whispering, dry] Technically correct. [deadpan, grave] Deeply concerning.

lines.speaker: Kit
lines.text: Your parcel is arriving any Tuesday now.
lines.script: [chipper, breezy] Your parcel is arriving any Tuesday now.

lines.speaker: Kit
lines.text: The snails asked for smaller uniforms.
lines.script: [chipper, deadpan] The snails asked for smaller uniforms.

lines.speaker: Kit
lines.text: I deliver good news. Bad news has to walk.
lines.script: [chipper] I deliver good news. [wry] Bad news has to walk.
